title: Rhapsody

sources.title: Gaping Wounds
markers: lacks a check for attack rolls

summary: A +1 dagger that builds kill bonuses and spends them on one of three powers.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +1 attack. Simple, light, finesse, thrown, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Scarlet Remittance: +1 to attack rolls, damage and spell save DC per living hostile creature you kill while wielding it, up to +3. Unequipping removes the bonus.
fields.Sweet Bloodletting: Hit with this dagger while hiding or invisible. DC 15 Constitution save or Bleeding for 2 turns. Bleeding deals 2 Slashing at turn start, gives disadvantage on Constitution saves and ends with healing.
fields.Scarlet Feast: Spend all three Scarlet Remittance stacks on one variant, once per Long Rest.
fields.Scarlet Saturation: Bonus Action. For 2 turns, your next successful attack deals critical damage. A miss does not spend it. The source reports it bypasses critical-hit immunity.
fields.Scarlet Stupor: Bonus Action. For 2 turns hostile creatures have disadvantage on saves against your spells.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action, proficient main hand, once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage on hit. Constitution save vs weapon-action DC +2 prevents 2 turns of Gaping Wounds. Undead and Constructs are immune. Successful attacks add 2 Piercing in standard modes. In Honour, damage sources add 2 of their original damage type. Healing removes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
